findings.description: The bind mount is at a path the pinned image never uses, so the sync database is written into the container's ephemeral writable layer instead of the host folder. adrianmusante/pocketbase:0.40.4 is a Bitnami-style image whose data directory defaults to ${POCKETBASE_WORKDIR}/data = /pocketbase/data (upstream v0.40.4 scripts/pocketbase-env.sh: POCKETBASE_DATA_DIR="${POCKETBASE_DATA_DIR:-"${POCKETBASE_WORKDIR}/data"}", POCKETBASE_WORKDIR="${POCKETBASE_WORKDIR:-/pocketbase}"), and its entrypoint launches `pocketbase serve ... --dir "$POCKETBASE_DATA_DIR"`.
